title: Uwell Viscore Watermelon Ice Pod & Refill - 20mg
description: The Uwell Viscore Prefilled Pod & Refill in Watermelon Ice blends the fresh, juicy flavour of watermelon with an invigorating menthol exhale, offering a cool and refreshing vape. Designed for the Uwell Viscore 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, this pack features a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill container, delivering exceptional value and usability. Equipped with a 0.8ohm mesh coil, the pod ensures smooth vapour production and bold flavour, perfect for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. The refill container allows for easy top-ups, extending the pod's usability for up to 8000 puffs, depending on personal usage. Preloaded with 20mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, the pod provides a silky throat hit and fast nicotine satisfaction, ideal for adult vapers seeking a high-quality and convenient vaping experience. Replace the pod and refill container when empty to continue enjoying the refreshing Watermelon Ice flavour.
